Queen's Blade: The Conquest is a free to play browser game made by Aiming, that used to be available here, until its service was discontinued on May 2013. The game features characters from the Queen's Blade franchise, and several from Queen's Blade: Rebellion.

Story[]

Evil monsters have occupied the areas around the continent, and with the help of each beautiful fighter to guide you, it's your job to restore the peace to the lands.

Characters[]

  • Starting characters: Leina, Cattleya, or Nyx.
  • Queen's Blade: Airi, Ymir, Irma, Risty, Nowa, Alleyne.
  • Rebellion: Annelotte, Mirim, Yuit & Vante, Sigui,Luna Luna, Tarnyang, Sainyang.

Gameplay[]

In normal mode, you go to each area and click to advance your way through the areas, and once you reach the boss of each of the 4 sections, you'll fight a battle in a typical turn-based RPG style. These battles only let you use one of your characters, but if you befriend other players, you'll be able to use their main characters in the battle, up to 4 characters at once. After the 3 bosses of each section are defeated, the 4th boss is the character that has been guiding you all along, that joins you if you win.

In Conquest mode, where you can send your characters to nearby territories to fight NPCs (if the area is empty) or other players (if the area belongs to them), claiming it if you win. You can also ally yourself with other players, sharing your territories.
